name: Steal an Anime!
desc:
Welcome to Steal an Anime! 🥷

[HOW TO PLAY]
1. Recruit an Anime Character who appears on the map🗺️
2. Collect Cash earnt by your Anime Characters!💸
3. Steal Anime Characters from other Players💰
4. Become the richest and flex your Anime Collection!🤑

Assemble your squad of powerful units! 🥊
Earn Cash and Upgrade your base! 💸
Steal from other players and protect your own! ⚔️

Check back everyday to see how much you've earnt, your heroes will earn cash OFFLINE!
Show your support with a Like & Favourite!

⭐ Join the group to redeem codes, then use code 'STAR' for a bonus! 
💯Members of Roblox Premium get 1.5x Money in the Time Chamber!
